module: World editor window (no title bar) that displays a legend of the shortcuts of the active edit mode. It reads either editor.editMode.getLegendCurrentActionNames(), or the actions of the mode's actionMap (keyboard and mouse bindings from core_input_bindings), plus editor.editMode.auxShortcuts, then sorts them and displays them inline. An editor tool modder fills auxShortcuts or getLegendCurrentActionNames so that their shortcuts appear.
notes: auxShortcuts is a table {editor.AuxControl_xxx flag or string = title}; numeric flags are combined into text (e.g. 'Ctrl + LMB').
The title goes through _tr() for translation.
The list is rebuilt only after an edit mode change (onEditorEditModeChanged).

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame of the editor UI: rebuilds the shortcut list if needed and draws the centered legend with key badges.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: fills the modifier name table (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, LMB, MMB, RMB, MouseWheel, Copy, Paste, etc.), registers and shows the shortcutLegend window.

onEditorEditModeChanged.desc: Hook called when the edit mode changes: requests a rebuild of the shortcut list.
